amendments: Amendment 1 (revision 2, before any timed data): arm-A positions sequential->restart after the preregistered smoke paused on a byte-identity failure; root cause = restart query block starts at max(doc_lengths) so the layouts are numerically different executions.

Amendment 2 (revision 3, at the L512_N10_H10_D8 identity pause, before further timed data): after diagnosing the divergence as bf16 reduction-order differences between the mathematically-equivalent joint-prefill and assembled-KV executions (identical positions/masks, identical fixed work), the sweep continues in record mode: per-cell identity verdicts recorded and reported, byte-identity claim scoped to cells where it holds. No grid/threshold/repeat/metric change.

motivation.v59_unoptimized_crossover: hit rates 0.616-0.733 at L=512, all-hit ~221 ms (unoptimized reuse)
motivation.unknown: where optimized reuse wins as a function of hit fraction h, document length L, decode budget

A_monolithic.execution: fresh encode+decode each request; shared SDPA model (canonical-on-sdpa execution, V64 audit qualifier (c)); mask build untimed (V65 arm-A convention); positions = build_positions(doc_lengths, query_len, 0, 'restart') per Amendment 1 (same-layout baseline; the V65 harness default sequential layout is a numerically different execution that diverges on some content — smoke-documented, no timed data affected)
A_monolithic.wall: synchronized wall around generate_ids(model, tokenizer, batch, 'ddi_qf', d, stop_on_eos=False)

B_optimized_reuse.execution: CanonicalCache(model, contract, DocCache store) V65-optimized path (2 GiB LRU, store-time validation markers, staged H2D); LRU-warm steady state
B_optimized_reuse.ttft: synchronized wall of cache.request(docs, query_ids) with max_new_tokens=None (documents + assembly + query forward; V65 arm-C convention)
B_optimized_reuse.wall: synchronized wall of cache.request(docs, query_ids, max_new_tokens=d, eos_token_id=None)
B_optimized_reuse.pre_state: hit_count of the N documents pre-stored in the cell DocCache before the timed section; fresh docs re-encode every pass and their write-through entries are pruned untimed after every pass so the pre-state is exact

frozen_asymmetries: arm-A TTFT excludes mask build, arm-B TTFT includes it (V65 convention behind the 2.05x anchor)
at fixed budget d the canonical decode loop performs d step forwards vs the monolithic d-1

grid.hit_count_rule: hit_count = min(N, max(0, floor(h*N + 0.5))) round-half-up; hit docs = first hit_count docs in request order; duplicate nominal h sharing a hit_count measured once and shared

doc_length_conditional.gate: runs only if elapsed wall < 105 min after both main L blocks complete

data.packing_rule: paragraph pool = all info_contexts paragraphs of the 100 dev records in ascending record-id then paragraph order, tokenized add_special_tokens=False; per (L,N) a cursor from pool position 0 accumulates whole consecutive paragraphs token-level until >= L then truncates to exactly L; consumed paragraphs fully consumed (remainder discarded); cursor resets per (L,N) so sets nest across N
data.query_rule: one fixed dev record picked by random.Random(47) over sorted dev ids; query = build_query_text(tokenizer, record), tokenized add_special_tokens=False
data.request_fixity: request (documents + query, in order) fixed per (L,N) and byte-identical across arms; arm-A batch = same token streams with build_positions(doc_lengths, query_len, 0, 'restart') per Amendment 1 (inference.encode(layout='restart') semantics, unit-tested for parity)
data.amendment_1: 2026-09-10, before any timed sweep data: arm-A positions sequential->restart after the preregistered smoke cell paused on a byte-identity failure; root cause = restart query block starts at max(doc_lengths) so the layouts are numerically different executions; no grid/threshold/repeat/metric change; revision-1 json sha 674578fb7d93a24cc56644e1d027d975be2093f610cee4457660d494c02e0b1a preserved

protocol.order: interleaved by repeat index: warmups (A,B) x3 then timed A_i,B_i for i=1..15; decode budget order within unit: TTFT/d=1 first, then 8, 16, 32, 64
protocol.store_hygiene: store file set verified against expected hit keys before and after every timed section; untimed prune of fresh write-through entries after every B pass
protocol.prereg_shrink_rule: if measured pace projects the remaining grid past the 3 h cap: timed repeats of remaining units 15->10 (floor 10), then drop L=32; the h grid is never shrunk; every change recorded as a deviation at run time
protocol.cap_enforcement: runner refuses to start a new (L,N,hit_count) unit after 165 min elapsed; hard cap 180 min
protocol.smoke_allowance: one mechanics-validation smoke cell (L=128, N=2, hit_count=2, d=8, 2 repeats) may run before the sweep; timings discarded, not reported

statistics.point: median of the 15 timed values per arm per cell
statistics.ci: paired percentile bootstrap 95% CI, 10000 resamples, seed 47, resampling repeat-index pairs
statistics.ratio: A/B ratio of medians (speedup; >1 means reuse faster); same estimator as scripts/run_v65_benchmark.paired_ratio_bootstrap

identity_checks.rule: per cell per repeat: arm-A and arm-B generated token id sequences byte-identical (covers documents served from cache)
identity_checks.on_divergence: pause the sweep and diagnose (original rule; fired at L512_N10_H10_D8). Amendment 2: after diagnosis the sweep continues in record mode -- per-repeat verdicts recorded per cell, divergent cells flagged identity_divergent, byte-identity claim scoped in the final report; never averaged away
identity_checks.amendment_2_diagnosis: bf16 reduction-order divergence between joint monolithic prefill and per-doc encode + assembled-KV query forward; mathematically equivalent, identical fixed work, timing unaffected

metrics.ttft: arm A: synchronized prefill model() wall (prefill_ms); arm B: synchronized wall of request(max_new_tokens=None); measured once per (L,N,hit_count), reported for every decode budget
metrics.wall: synchronized wall around the whole fixed-work greedy arm call (d new tokens; includes mask build / assembly)
metrics.prewarming: untimed per-(L,N) hit-store encode wall, reported separately from steady-state statistics

cost.nominal_arm_cells: 8 h x 2-3 L x 3 N x 5 budgets x 2 arms = 480 (720 with L=32)
cost.measured_units: 16 (L,N,h) units per L x 5 budgets x 2 arms; ~7700 timed+warmup passes

infeasible_cell_rule: mark status=infeasible with exception text in per-cell summary and crossover table; continue; torch.cuda.empty_cache() before next unit

checkpointing.restart: skip unit-cells already status=ok in progress.jsonl (unit granularity otherwise)

analysis_plan.crossover: per (L, decode budget): smallest nominal h in the frozen grid whose wall verdict is win; same for TTFT per (L) (TTFT is decode-budget-independent and repeated per budget row); 'none in grid' if no cell wins
analysis_plan.figures: median wall speedup A/B vs h with bootstrap-CI bands and win/tie/lose markers; hlines at 1.0, 1.05, 1/1.05; same for TTFT; PNG+PDF
